caption:
Brass doors, white gloves, the door held open. Some buildings still know how to say goodbye.

#newyorkcity #artdeco #elevator
alt_text: In an art-deco lobby of black marble and brass, a woman whose skin and carved updo are polished grey-ivory marble with thin gold veins steps out of a gold elevator in a black tuxedo jacket, burgundy satin blouse and cream trousers, while an elderly operator in white gloves holds the door.
